senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; חָלַל Hif.) beginning, start, first stage.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 31a:2">Naz. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>תְּחִילַּת הקדש</he> the primary stage of consecration, i.e. the consecrated object itself, opp. <he>סוף הקדש</he> the secondary consecration, i.e. the exchange.
B. Bath. 128ᵃ שתְּחִילָּתוֹ וכ׳, v. פַּסְלוּת; a. v. fr.—Esp. (sub. לטומאה) first degree of uncleanness (v. רִאשׁוֹן).
<cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 5:1">Zab. V, 1</cite> <he>מטמא … להיות ת׳</he> makes eatables and liquors unclean in the first degree, opp. <he>שְׁנִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 3:1">Yad. III, 1</cite> <he>הידים ת׳ בכל מקום</he> hands (touching an unclean object) become unclean in the first degree under all conditions.

Ib. I, 4 ת׳ לקודש is unclean in the first degree with regard to consecrated things (sacrificial meat &c.); a. fr.—Pl. תְּחִלּוֹת, תְּחִי׳. Yad. l. c.; Ḥull. 33ᵇ; a. fr.—בַּתְּחִלָּה, or ת׳ in the beginning, before, first.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 2:2">Ber. II, 2</cite> <he>עול … ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00240"><he>עוֹל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 37a:3">Ib. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מברך עליו ת׳ וסוף</he> he must say the benediction over it before and after eating.
Ib. בת׳ מברך עליו וכ׳ before eating he must say &c.; a. fr.—מִתְּ׳ from the beginning, originally, in olden times.
<cite ref="Pesachim 116a:11">Pes. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>מת׳ עובדי וכ׳</he> our forefathers in olden times were idolaters; a. e.—<he>לְכַתְּ׳</he>, <he>לְכִתְ׳</he>

<cite ref="Eruvin 34b:15">Erub. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>פוחת לכת׳ ונוטל</he> he may directly dig out, and take; <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00486"><he>פָּחַת</he></cite>; a. fr.—
